meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会化身安装医生:自动拉取 LazyCodex 和 Codex 最新源码,检查本地版本、配置、插件和命令行工具,逐项对比是否过期或损坏,给出带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告及修复建议,且不会改动你的安装。
howto.when: 当用户要求做健康检查、提到 LazyCodex 等关键词,或发现 Codex 在安装/更新/改配置后行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 和 Codex 的安装是否正常
say.note: 生成一份带证据的健康报告。

say.text: 我刚更新了 Codex,现在有点不对劲,查查是不是配置过期了
say.note: 会对比最新源码找出漂移。

say.text: 看看我的 Codex 安装和最新版差多少
say.note: 列出版本差异和修复建议。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an install doctor: fetches latest LazyCodex/Codex sources, inspects local version, config, plugins, CLI, compares for staleness/breakage, and outputs an evidence-backed PASS/WARN/FAIL report with fixes. It never mutates your install.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a health check or doctor, mentions LazyCodex or omo-codex keywords, or reports Codex misbehaving after install/update/config change.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex and Codex installs are healthy
I just updated Codex and it seems off; see if my config is stale
say_en.note: Compares against latest sources to find drift.

say_en.text: How far is my Codex install from the latest version?
say_en.note: Lists version gaps and remediation steps.
